# mtncloud_network_group (Data Source)

Provides a MTN Cloud network group data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_network_group" "tf_example_network_group" {
  name = "TF Example Network Group"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the MTN Cloud network group

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the network group is active or not
- `description` (String) The description of the network group
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `visibility` (String) Whether the network group is visible in sub-tenants or not
